modules.module_title: Select the site for hydroponic farming

pcs.pc_description: select a location with the required temperature and sunlight exposure, suitable to the selected plant/ crop variety
ensure the availability of various inputs such as water, electricity, fertilisers and labour for hydroponic farming
prepare the tabulation of the crop, following the recommended process
select the appropriate hydroponic technique for growing quality medium to obtain quality produce of the chosen crop
select an appropriate nutrient circulation method such as the Nutrient Film Technique, Deep Flow Technique (DFT), wick system, water culture, EBB and Flower etc
insert plants placed in plastic net pots, in the holes made in PVC pipes
use the recommended flooring material in the hydroponic farm, that is capable of soaking in any spillage and leakages
adopt the Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) for leafy plants for their faster growth (Selection of Hydroponics)
place plants in growing tubes and suspend them into water
maintain a reservoir to hold the nutrient solution and pump it as per the requirement to the tubes of growing plants as a back up
automate the nutrient flow system using the cyclic monitoring application, as required
ensure the availability of adequate lighting for the optimum growth of plants in the hydroponic system through the use of a relevant lighting system
check the pipes for any salt deposits and remove (cleaning of NFT channels /pipes) it safely to prevent choking and ensure the nutrient solution flows without obstruction through the pipes
check and ensure that the roots of plants get an appropriate quantity of nutrient solution for healthy growth
clean and monitor the condition of motors controlling water tanks, pumps, and growing trays
use clean water in the hydroponic system and maintain the pH level of the water by using the recommended treatment
clean the floor and maintain it dry in the hydroponic system
use mesh filters for regular cleaning
check the pH & EC regularly and follow the recommended practices to adjust it to the required level in the hydroponic system and nutrient solution, as required
use the oxygen meter with mobile application support and alarm to monitor the level of dissolved oxygen in the nutrient solution and follow the recommended practices to maintain or adjust it
clean the hydroponic system regularly using agriculture grade acid or other recommended treatment, and flush the system with clean water before replanting
use auto-cleaning systems for cleaning in large-scale hydroponic systems to save time and achieve better productivity
carry out artificial pollination using blowers, and use mechanical vibrators to improve air quality within the protected hydroponic system structures
replace damaged parts or components as needed
